integrity: Stationary polynomial generator, exact symbolic resolvent, signed-core convexity and positive-convolution proof; numerical reproducibility is secondary evidence. Previous equal-model transform is explicitly acknowledged. No independent audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Normalized harmonic filter of Brownian bath reset at a constant Poisson rate; full-lag fourth-order sign only. Earlier exact quartic transform and existence are prior mathematics; new complete zero-count classification. Does not infer pathwise entropy production, finite-sample power, or non-Poisson robustness.
title: A complete one-crossing phase diagram for a fourth-order time arrow in a resetting Brownian bath
